method: Rows dated 2026-11-18 were restated from pages opened on 18 November 2026. Rows dated 2026-11-19 were restated from pages opened on 19 November 2026. The app does not download these pages. Meltan and Melmetal are not in the untradable list because the Help Center page does not state that exception.
